purpose: LRM 4.6.4.4 noise_table_log: log-log interpolation, not linear, between knots

oracle.derivation: Same 500 ohm flat transfer impedance as the linear decks. Table (1e3,1e-18) (1e6,1e-24). LRM 4.6.4.4: P = pow(10, log(p1) + (log(p2)-log(p1))*(log(f)-log(f1))/(log(f2)-log(f1))). Here log10(p2/p1) = -6 over log10(f2/f1) = 3, so the exponent is -2 and the closed form is S_I(f) = 1e-18*(f/1000)^-2. f=1000 is the first tabulated row: S_I = 1.0e-18 exactly (the formula degenerates to p1), onoise = 500*1e-9 = 5.0e-07. f=2000: S_I = 1e-18/4 = 2.5e-19, onoise = 500*sqrt(2.5e-19) = 2.5e-07. f=3000: S_I = 1e-18/9 = 1.1111111111111111e-19, onoise = 500*(1e-9/3) = 1.6666666666666667e-07. DISCRIMINATION: applying 4.6.4.3's linear rule to these same knots would give S_I(2000) = 1e-18 + (1e-24-1e-18)*1000/999000 = 9.98999e-19 and onoise = 4.9975e-07, a factor of 2 off, so this fixture separates the two clauses rather than merely exercising a lookup.
